set.signal: Sugon is named among Huafeng Technology's customers in its 2026 half-year report: in its communications business the company says it continues to serve top domestic server and communications-equipment makers such as Huawei, Inspur, xFusion and Sugon on a long-term, stable basis.

items.reason: Source lists them as top domestic server AND communications-equipment makers (communications business section), not server makers only.
